gloss: to pile up, to load, to accumulate

definitions.explanation: To place things on top of each other.
To put cargo onto a vehicle.
To build up experience or achievements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧のように{積|つ}まれている。
examples.english: Documents are piled up like a mountain on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積|つ}む。
examples.english: To load luggage onto a car.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To load cargo onto a truck.

examples.english: We loaded food onto the ship and departed.

⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}む。
⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて、⟦ようやく→漸く：00429_youyaku⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After accumulating years of effort, results finally appeared.

notes:
{積|つ}む means to pile up, stack, load, or accumulate—physically stacking things or figuratively building up experience.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {積|つ}もる (intransitive, to pile up by itself)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{積|つ}む: to load luggage
- {経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}む: to gain/accumulate experience
- {練習|れんしゅう}を{積|つ}む: to build up practice
- {努力|どりょく}を{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる: to make sustained effort

COMPOUNDS:
- {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる: to pile up, accumulate
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}む: to load (onto vehicle)
- {山積|やまづ}み: piled high like a mountain
